content: Tables TABREF27 and TABREF31 show BLEU scores of all the models, except the NMT systems augmented with back-translations. Whereas some models achieved reasonable BLEU scores for Ja INLINEFORM0 En and Ru INLINEFORM1 En translation, all the results for Ja INLINEFORM2 Ru, which is our main concern, were abysmal.
